title: Ardent AI
excerpt: The AI Agent that adapts to your business, not the other way around.
content_html:
Meet Ardent

The AI agent that adapts to your business, not the other way around.

Download for Mac

Ardent

/

Chat Feature Usage Insights

Ask Ardent

Kimi 2.6

A custom AI agent can give your business an edge, but building one from scratch has tradeoffs.

Ardent is the fastest way to empower your whole company with custom agents, without building the infrastructure yourself.

Skip the plumbing

Streaming, context management, permissions, memory, sandboxing, MCP. A production grade agent out of the box.

Streaming

Extensibility

MCP

Skills

Memory

Authentication

Extensibility

Focus on the last mile instead

Customize Ardent with the data, decisions, and logic that make your business unique.

Engineers have coding agents.

Ardent is for everyone else.

A general-purpose agent for all knowledge work

Designed for collaboration and teams

Customized to your business

One person's breakthrough becomes everyone's baseline

Most AI tools are solitary, and what you learn and build stays with you. Ardent is a shared workspace where solved problems become reusable abilities. Anyone can share abilities with everyone else at your company with a single click.

Engineered for efficiency

Traditional agents load raw data into the model, which is slow and expensive. Ardent takes a faster, more cost-effective approach.

0%

Fewer model tokens than Claude Cowork*

0%

Fewer model requests per task

*Based on five representative complex business tasks completed in both Ardent and Claude Cowork (Opus 5).

Code does the heavy lifting

Ardent writes reusable code that pulls from your spreadsheets, databases, and APIs, handles processing in an isolated sandbox, and loads only minimal data into the context window.

So your company can tackle bigger problems more efficiently

Our code-generation approach means large, messy, multi-source tasks that would be too expensive for traditional agents become routine with Ardent.

Enabling you to solve problems beyond the context window

Point Ardent at a pile of files, a full database, or a dozen disconnected systems. It writes code to handle the volume rather than trying to keep it all in context at once.

At a fraction of the cost

Ardent runs on a mix of open-weight models, including GLM, MiniMax, and Kimi, picking the right one for each job. Every task costs a fraction of what the frontier models cost, and our code-first approach compounds the savings.

Production-ready from the start

Building an agent involves more than calling an LLM. Ardent provides all the core agent infrastructure out of the box, so you can focus on the workflows that make your business unique.

Secure Sandbox

Ardent runs in an isolated environment, so untrusted code never touches your systems.

Authentication

Ardent connects to your tools with credentials that stay scoped and revocable.

Memory

Ardent remembers decisions, files, and context across runs.

Extensibility

Add new tools and integrations without builds or deployments.

Streaming

Watch every step as it happens, with live output from the first token onward.

MCP

Native support for MCP servers connects Ardent to any compatible tool or data source.

Permissions

Ardent asks before it acts, and only does what you've explicitly allowed.

Abilities

Package reusable workflows agents can run on demand.

Simple, at-cost pricing

No per-seat fees, subscriptions, or contracts.

No daily or monthly caps.

No markup: you pay exactly what your usage costs.

Prepay for credits, and optionally auto-refill.

Frequently asked questions

Which models does Ardent use, and what do they cost?

Ardent currently chooses between GLM 5.2, GLM 5.3 Flash, MiniMax M3, and Kimi K3, picking the best fit for each task. During the beta, usage is billed at cost through OpenRouter, with no markup from us. The rates below are the most we pay per model; actual cost is often lower depending on which OpenRouter provider serves the request.
